02

Data deletion details

Here is what the request covers and what may remain outside Live Moment.

Deleted

  • Your Live Moment account and profile
  • Uploaded photos, generated images and videos stored by Live Moment
  • Generation history and other app records linked to your account

Not deleted or retained separately

  • Copies you exported to your device, backups or other services
  • Your Google account and Google Play subscription
  • Limited provider copies, security logs or backups kept under applicable retention requirements

Deleting your account does not cancel a Google Play subscription. Cancel any active subscription separately in Google Play before or after sending your request.
